regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, introduction, and article metadata
regions.finding: Article identity and aggregate ATA claim inspected. Prior allene/carbohydrate methods and cited references are background rather than current-paper experiments. The paper states no supplied SI association on this page; no SI facts were inferred.

regions.region: page 1 right-column optimization narrative
regions.finding: The prose reports the six model-substrate results later tabulated in Table 1. These are linked to the six Table 1 records rather than duplicated; the 2.0 mmol scale and entry-1 reduced paraformaldehyde/amine loadings are retained.

regions.region: page 1 bottom Scheme 1
regions.finding: The generic carbohydrate alkyne-to-terminal-allene transformation under conditions A or B is classified as a general scheme. Its printed yield ranges are aggregate outcomes, not assigned to an invented single preparation.

unresolved: Scheme 1 contains generic R/X/m definitions and does not define a unique structure or scale.
Complex carbohydrate stereochemistry remains label-only and machine-unverified.

regions.region: page 2 upper Table 1 drawing, entries 1–6, and footnotes a–b
regions.finding: Six independent optimization experiments were retained with catalyst identity/loading, amine identity/loading, paraformaldehyde loading, 2 mmol substrate, 3 mL dioxane, 110 °C, row time, and isolated yield. Entry 1 applies the footnote's 1.6/1.4-equivalent overrides.

regions.region: page 2 scope discussion and Figure 1 reference
regions.finding: Narrative maps to Table 2 entries 1–8 and reports X-ray characterization of 2e. ORTEP characterization is linked to the 2e experiments and is not another preparation.

regions.region: page 2 lower Table 2 drawing, entries 1–8, and footnotes a–c
regions.finding: Each A/B condition cell was retained as an independent scope experiment (16 records), including row-specific scale/yield and the 13 h condition-B override for entry 6. Conditions A/B were not merged by shared product label.

unresolved: Table-only scope rows omit exact masses, solvent volume, atmosphere, workup, purification, and isolated mass unless detailed on page 6.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Figure 1 ORTEP of 2e
regions.finding: ORTEP supports the source assignment of 2e but is characterization, not an independent reaction and not machine-structure verification.

regions.region: page 3 Scheme 2
regions.finding: Four independent experiments were retained: 1i and 1j each under conditions A and B, with separate 58/69% and 67/69% isolated yields.

regions.region: page 3 Scheme 3
regions.finding: Four independent disaccharide allenylations were retained: 1k and 1l each under conditions A and B, with separate 70/71% and 75/79% yields.

regions.region: page 3 Scheme 4
regions.finding: Two distinct fivefold allenylations of 1m were retained under modified A and B reagent loadings, giving 2m in 58% and 61% isolated yield.

unresolved: Schemes 2–4 omit atmosphere, workup, purification, isolated mass, and most absolute quantities.
ORTEP evidence does not certify candidate structure encodings.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left General Information
regions.finding: Analytical methods, chromatography conventions, and reagent suppliers were inspected as shared context; they are not independent reaction experiments.

regions.region: page 4 left column and Scheme 5 preparation of 1c
regions.finding: A distinct 35 mmol azide-to-amide preparation was retained with exact masses/volumes, 15 min addition, N2/r.t./48 h, workup, chromatography, 8.4737 g product, and 52% isolated yield.

regions.region: page 4 upper-right and Scheme 6 preparation of 1d
regions.finding: A distinct 30 mmol malonate substitution was retained with K2CO3/dimethyl malonate/DMSO, 40 °C for 4 d, acid-neutralization workup, chromatography/recrystallization, 5.5364 g, and 40% isolated yield.

regions.region: page 4 lower-right beginning of 1g preparation
regions.finding: The 1f-to-1g malonate substitution begins here and continues on page 5; it is represented once with cross-page evidence.

unresolved: The 1d/1g reaction atmospheres are not reported.

regions.region: page 5 upper Scheme 7 and continuation of 1g characterization
regions.finding: The page completes the existing 1f-to-1g experiment with the printed structure, chromatography/recrystallization context, 8.4323 g product, and 40% isolated yield; no duplicate was created.

regions.region: page 5 left column and Scheme 8 preparation of 1k
regions.finding: A distinct BF3·OEt2-promoted glycosylation of 4 and 5 was retained with exact scale, CH2Cl2, r.t./12 h, workup, chromatography, 7.9667 g, and 62% isolated yield.

regions.region: page 5 right column and Scheme 9 preparation of 1l
regions.finding: A distinct BF3·OEt2-promoted glycosylation of 6 and 5 was retained with exact scale, CH2Cl2, r.t./12 h, workup, chromatography, 5.5272 g, and 64% isolated yield; characterization continues onto page 6.

unresolved: The glycosylation atmospheres are not reported.
Complex disaccharide stereochemistry remains label-only and unverified.

regions.region: page 6 upper-left continuation of 1l characterization
regions.finding: Spectroscopic/elemental data continue the page-5 1l preparation and do not define a second experiment.

regions.region: page 6 left column detailed conditions-A and conditions-B preparations of 2a
regions.finding: The two exact 10 mmol runs enrich Table 2 entry 1 A/B with reagent masses/amounts, solvent/amine volumes, time, chromatography, 2.5569/2.8925 g product masses, and 64/72% isolated yields.

regions.region: page 6 center/right detailed conditions-A and conditions-B preparations of 2b
regions.finding: The two exact 10 mmol runs enrich Table 2 entry 2 A/B with exact quantities, chromatography, 2.6465/2.7449 g product masses, and 52/54% isolated yields.

regions.region: page 6 right column detailed conditions-A and conditions-B preparations of 2c
regions.finding: The two exact 5 mmol runs enrich Table 2 entry 3 A/B, retaining the 41.61 wt% 1c/dioxane solution masses, reagent quantities, added dioxane, chromatography, 1.5526/1.3260 g product masses, and 64/55% yields.

regions.region: page 6 lower-right beginning of 2d conditions-A preparation
regions.finding: The exact 3 mmol condition-A quantities and chromatography enrich Table 2 entry 4 A. The detailed paragraph continues onto page 7, so only the already tabulated 50% yield and page-6 facts were retained.

unresolved: Page-6 detailed ATA paragraphs do not report atmosphere and give only limited workup operations.
The 2d condition-A paragraph continues onto uninspected page 7; no page-7 product mass or characterization was imported.
